questions.q: Why do you believe what you believe, and could you explain it to a friend?
questions.answer: One example: "I trust Jesus, but honestly I'd struggle to explain why. This year I want a real reason I could share with a friend, with gentleness and respect."

questions.q: Peter ran from the cross, then spoke boldly in Acts. What changed him?
questions.answer: He had seen and heard things he couldn't keep quiet about. In Acts 4:20 he says they can't stop speaking about what they saw and heard.

questions.q: Is there a question about your faith you have never felt safe asking?
questions.answer: One example: "How do we really know the Bible is true?" It helps to hear that any question is welcome here, and that we can work out answers together.
